end.summary:
Recognised that fractions describe equal parts of a shape.
Practised naming halves, thirds, and quarters.
Worked on one-third of 15 pencils and identified 5 pencils.
Repeatedly named 2/3 for 2 eaten out of 5 chocolate-bar parts; whole-versus-left mix-up remained.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised equal shares, fraction names, and finding one-third of 15 pencils. Nisha used the three equal groups to find 5 pencils. A mix-up remained when naming 2 eaten parts out of 5 total parts: they used the 3 parts left as the denominator, and it was not corrected by the end. At home, draw shapes split into equal parts and ask, “How many parts are shaded out of how many parts altogether?”
